verdict.rationale: Glama's /mcp/reference page says users can search its curated catalog of servers and connectors, inspect their capabilities, and sync their own directory, which points to a documented programmatic catalog API. An llms.txt describing the directory of about 91k servers also resolves. However, the evidence is a single thin line with no endpoint details, and no OpenAPI spec could be found at the probed paths. missing for 10: concrete API endpoint/schema documentation (search, filter, tool listing), machine-readable OpenAPI spec, auth/rate-limit details, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven catalog queries
